detail.longDescription: Yes, it's another # etcd patch release! Given the state of things, you can expect a patch release at least every month for the forseeable future. https:// etcd.io/blog/2026/nov-17-patch -release/ Fortunately, this one doesn't patch any critical security vulns, so you can wait for your regular maintenance cycle (you do have one, right?) to apply it. # Kubernetes
